$comment: Who answers a raised hand. Every stall kind scripts/raised-hands.mjs can auto-detect MUST have a route here, and every named responder must exist (an agent in .claude/agents, a skill in .claude/skills, a lane, or the owner) — `node scripts/raised-hands.mjs --check` fails otherwise, so a new detector cannot ship without somebody who answers it. The hand-dispatcher agent (.claude/agents/hand-dispatcher.md) follows .claude/skills/raised-hands/SKILL.md and reads this table. Owner, 2026-09-23: 'build something that monitors the raise your hand function then apply what is needed for the agents to address or create new agent and or skill to fill that gap.'

mail.action: The addressed lane runs `pnpm run lane:inbox`, does what each message asks, and acks it with what was done (`pnpm run lane:deliver ack <id> "…"`). A cloud-addressed message is the steward cycle's; a mac-addressed one waits for a Mac session — the cloud raises a covering hand naming what is unread, it never acks for the Mac.

sim.action: The Mac tick runs queued requests every 5 minutes; a request still pending past 48h means the tick is not running or the operation cannot run on this machine. Check the tick heartbeat first; if it is fresh, the Mac session reads the request and either runs it (`pnpm run sim:run-requests --id <id>`) or supersedes it with the reason.

heartbeat.action: A launchd routine (the Mac tick) that went silent is a physical Mac: escalate ONCE per 24h to the owner with the one command (`bash scripts/mac/install-launchd.sh`, then `--status`). A cloud trigger that went silent: read list_triggers for its last_run; a FAILED or missing run is re-fired or repaired by the cloud lane, never waited out.

alternates.when: the failing step is a gate, proof or self-test under scripts/

pr-red.action: Read the failing check run's log, root-cause it on the PR's branch, push a fix with the full local gates run first (CLAUDE.md, 'Before you push'). A failure that is not the PR's own gets one comment naming the failing check and why.

alternates.when: the PR is the cloud lane's own and not owner-gated — land it under DR-037 (.claude/skills/landing-under-dr-037)

pr-idle.action: A green PR idle 48h is waiting on a merge decision. If DR-037 lets the cloud land it, land it. Otherwise it goes into the owner's ONE bundled message (owner-comms): the PR, what it does in one line, merge or close.

owner.action: Never act for the owner. Put every open owner hand into one short bundled message (owner-comms): what is stuck, the one thing he needs to do, where. The hourly raised-hands issue already notifies him of NEW hands; the bundle is for hands he has not acted on in 48h (OVERDUE).

capability-gap.action: A hand no route above can answer, or one that keeps coming back, is a missing capability. Name the recurring pattern; then either write a skill (the pattern is a procedure a session can follow) or hire an agent under DR-016 (a registered tier, charter and disjoint write scope in docs/agent/agent-tiers.json), and add its route to this file in the same PR.
